standards.applies_because: Luminaire safety, general requirements (incl. stability of portable luminaires)
Photobiological safety (blue-light hazard) of the LED source
Li-ion cell shipped inside the product

risks.risk: Lamp tips over when the arm is extended
risks.mitigation: Steel weight plate in the base, low centre of mass, anti-slip feet

risks.risk: LED board runs hot in a closed head
risks.mitigation: Aluminium MCPCB on the metal stem as heat spreader, thermal derating in firmware

risks.risk: Charging while in use overheats the cell
risks.mitigation: Charger IC thermal regulation, NTC on the cell

tests.name: Stability on an inclined plane
tests.method: Luminaire on the inclined plane in its least favourable position

tests.name: Temperature rise of LED head and cell
tests.method: Full brightness until steady state, thermocouples

prototype.method: SLA resin head + FDM base, aluminium stem from stock tube
steps: Bench the LED bar + driver with a lab supply, check flicker and temperature
Print head and base; cut the stem from stock aluminium tube
Assemble the quick-turn PCBA and the 18650 cell holder
Inclined-plane stability check with the arm in the worst position
Thermal run at full brightness for 1 h
